candidates.name: Cerebral vasculitis
support_spans: Noncontrast head CT demonstrated a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage
Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings suggest inflammation of the blood vessels in the brain

candidates.name: Subacute bacterial endocarditis
support_spans: febrile and intermittently responsive
leukocytosis (white blood cell count rising from 10.0 to 14.6 × 10^3/µL)
contradict_spans: Transthoracic echocardiography showed no valvular vegetations
candidates.why: The patient's fever and leukocytosis could be indicative of a bacterial infection

candidates.name: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
support_spans: Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema
Repeat MRI demonstrated progression with new involvement of the left basal ganglia
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings and clinical progression are consistent with this rare demyelinating disease

candidates.name: Hepatic encephalopathy

candidates.name: Toxic leukoencephalopathy
support_spans: Urine toxicology was positive for benzodiazepines and opiates
